# Game Idea: Spike Runner

- **Genre:** Endless runner
- **Controls:** Spacebar to jump
- **Gameplay:** A player block runs automatically across a scrolling ground. Random spikes appear from the right. The player must jump over spikes. Speed gradually increases.
- **Lose condition:** Colliding with a spike or falling off the ground ends the game.

<content>
1: // Simple endless runner based on IDEA.md
2: const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
3: const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
4: canvas.width = 800;
5: canvas.height = 200;
6: // Height of the ground strip where player runs
7: const groundHeight = 20;
8: // Audio setup
9: const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
10: function playTone(freq, duration) {
11:   const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
12:   const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
13:   osc.frequency.value = freq;
14:   osc.type = 'sine';
15:   osc.connect(gain);
16:   gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
17:   gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
18:   gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
19:   gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
20:   osc.start();
21:   osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
22: }
23: function playJumpSound() { playTone(440, 0.1); }
24: function playGameOverSound() { playTone(150, 0.5); }
25: 
26: // Game settings
27: let speed = 2; // base scroll speed (pixels/frame)
28: const speedIncrement = 0.001; // accelerate over time
29: const gravity = 0.6;
30: const jumpStrength = -12;
31: const groundHeight = 20; // height of ground strip
32: 
33: // Player block
34: const player = {
35:   x: 50,
36:   y: canvas.height - 40,
37:   width: 30,
38:   height: 30,
39:   vy: 0,
40:   onGround: true,
41:   draw() {
42:     // draw player as rounded rectangle
43:     const radius = 6;
44:     ctx.fillStyle = '#4A90E2';
45:     ctx.beginPath();
46:     ctx.moveTo(this.x + radius, this.y);
47:     ctx.lineTo(this.x + this.width - radius, this.y);
48:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(this.x + this.width, this.y, this.x + this.width, this.y + radius);
49:     ctx.lineTo(this.x + this.width, this.y + this.height - radius);
50:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(this.x + this.width, this.y + this.height, this.x + this.width - radius, this.y + this.height);
51:     ctx.lineTo(this.x + radius, this.y + this.height);
52:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(this.x, this.y + this.height, this.x, this.y + this.height - radius);
53:     ctx.lineTo(this.x, this.y + radius);
54:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(this.x, this.y, this.x + radius, this.y);
55:     ctx.closePath();
56:     ctx.fill();
57:   },
58:   update() {
59:     this.vy += gravity;
60:     this.y += this.vy;
61:     if (this.y + this.height >= canvas.height) {
62:       this.y = canvas.height - this.height;
63:       this.vy = 0;
64:       this.onGround = true;
65:     } else {
66:       this.onGround = false;
67:     }
68:   },
69:   jump() {
70:     if (this.onGround) {
71:       this.vy = jumpStrength;
72:       this.onGround = false;
73:     }
74:   }
75: };
76: 
77: // Spikes
78: const spikes = [];
79: const spikeWidth = 20;
80: const spikeHeight = 30;
81: let spikeTimer = 0;
82: const spikeInterval = 90; // frames between spikes (adjusted by speed)
83: 
84: function addSpike() {
85:   spikes.push({
86:     x: canvas.width,
87:     y: canvas.height - spikeHeight,
88:     width: spikeWidth,
89:     height: spikeHeight
90:   });
91: }
92: 
93: function updateSpikes() {
94:   for (let i = spikes.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
95:     const s = spikes[i];
96:     s.x -= speed;
97:     if (s.x + s.width < 0) spikes.splice(i, 1);
98:   }
99: }
100: 
101: function drawSpikes() {
102:   ctx.fillStyle = '#D0021B';
103:   spikes.forEach(s => {
104:     // draw triangle spike
105:     ctx.beginPath();
106:     ctx.moveTo(s.x, s.y + s.height);
107:     ctx.lineTo(s.x + s.width / 2, s.y);
108:     ctx.lineTo(s.x + s.width, s.y + s.height);
109:     ctx.closePath();
110:     ctx.fill();
111:   });
112: }
113: 
114: function checkCollision() {
115:   for (const s of spikes) {
116:     if (
117:       player.x < s.x + s.width &&
118:       player.x + player.width > s.x &&
119:       player.y < s.y + s.height &&
120:       player.y + player.height > s.y
121:     ) {
122:       return true;
123:     }
124:   }
125:   return false;
126: }
127: 
128: let gameOver = false;
129: function gameLoop() {
130:   if (gameOver) return;
131:   ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
132: 
133:   // Update speed gradually
134:   speed += speedIncrement;
135: 
136:   // Player update
137:   player.update();
138:   player.draw();
139: 
140:   // Spike handling
141:   spikeTimer++;
142:   if (spikeTimer > spikeInterval / speed) { // faster spikes as speed rises
143:     addSpike();
144:     spikeTimer = 0;
145:   }
146:   updateSpikes();
147:   drawSpikes();
148: 
149:   // Collision detection
150:   if (checkCollision()) {
151:     gameOver = true;
152:     // Play game over sound
153:     playGameOverSound();
154:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
155:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
156:     ctx.fillStyle = '#FFF';
157:     ctx.font = '30px sans-serif';
158:     ctx.textAlign = 'center';
159:     ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
160:     return;
161:   }
162: 
163:   requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
164: }
165: 
166: // Input handling
167: window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
168:   if (e.code === 'Space') {
169:     e.preventDefault();
170:     player.jump();
171:     playJumpSound();
172:   }
173: });
174: 
175: // Start
176: requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);

(End of file - total 176 lines)
</content>
